agent_explanation: Close encounter of the two heavy bodies (0 and 1, m~17 and 18) with G~4.73. Distance drops to ~1.45 at step 9 while acceleration is large. Leapfrog substep count (10-11 per outer dt=0.0176) is insufficient to integrate the stiff softened gravity accurately; pairwise forces become asymmetric over the substeps, injecting net momentum. Halving dt removes the error and restores conservation.
